f7cacb26-8257-4f61-88ac-89ece684a21c.name: Frost Breath
rules: Tap up to two target creatures. Those creatures don't untap during their controller's next untap step.

c3948634-7bb6-48c3-814b-f931635096d3.name: Radiation
rules: At the beginning of each player's precombat main phase, if that player has one or more rad counters, mill that many cards. For each nonland card milled this way, you lose 1 life and remove one rad counter.
